working_complete_elementary_reductions.name: annulus pair capture from spanning-arc control
working_complete_elementary_reductions.argument: Assume pi2(E)=0 and pi1(P)->pi1(E) injective. Give annulus its two boundary circles, one joining arc and one2cell. If f of the joining arc is homotopic rel endpoints into P, use finite CW HEP to arrange the entire1skeleton in P. Its attaching loop is null in E and hence null in P by injection. Fill it in P. The original2cell and this new filling have the same boundary; their difference is a sphere map, null by pi2(E)=0, so the fillings are homotopic rel boundary. This gives a homotopy through pair maps into P. Consequently failure of pair capture forces a genuine W-essential spanning arc. A proved W-essential annulus theorem then gives an embedded incompressible boundary-incompressible annulus; its boundary compression would contract the spanning-arc obstruction. Existing atoroidal-annulus supplier contradicts non-Seifertness. Missing part is the actual W-essential annulus theorem, not this finite-CW reduction.

working_complete_elementary_reductions.name: all abelian subgroups from three exact group inputs
working_complete_elementary_reductions.argument: Suppose torsion-free G has no nonidentity element divisible by infinitely many positive integers, every embedded Z2 subgroup is conjugate into P, and P is malnormal. Let B<=G be noncyclic abelian. If B contains independent a,b, their Z2 lies in a conjugate of P; conjugate B accordingly. For nonzero a in that Z2 and any c in B, a belongs to P intersect cPc^-1, so malnormality gives c in P. Hence B<=P. Otherwise B is torsion-free rank one. Fix0!=a in B; each b determines a unique rational n/m by mb=na, embedding B in Q with a=1. If B is not cyclic, reduced denominators are unbounded (bounded denominators put B inside(1/D)Z). For p/q in B in reduced form, Bezout up+vq=1 gives u(p/q)+v=1/q in B. Thus a has qth roots for infinitely many q, contradiction. This explicitly handles non-finitely-generated rank-one B rather than assuming it absent.

working_complete_elementary_reductions.name: torus maps realize Z2 subgroups
working_complete_elementary_reductions.argument: An embedded Z2 subgroup has commuting generating loops. Their commutator is null, so filling the single torus2cell realizes that subgroup by a pi1-injective torus map. Thus genuine torus-map capture gives the Z2 subgroup input above. The reverse homotopy assertion needs pi2(E)=0 to compare fillings and must not be inferred from group containment alone without that input.
